title: About Us
content_html:
Welcome to Custom Perfume Boxes, where we specialize in creating exquisite and bespoke packaging solutions tailored to enhance your fragrance products. At Custom Perfume Boxes, we understand that the first impression of your perfume lies in its packaging, and we are committed to making that impression unforgettable.

Our Mission

Our mission is to provide luxury packaging that not only protects your perfume but also elevates its appeal. We are dedicated to offering high-quality, customizable packaging solutions that reflect the essence of your brand. Whether you’re looking for a classic design or something more innovative, we are here to bring your vision to life.

Why Choose Us?

  • Customization: We offer a wide range of customization options to ensure that your packaging is as unique as your fragrance. From materials and finishes to design and printing, we collaborate with you to create packaging that aligns with your brand’s identity.

  • Quality: We prioritize quality in every step of our process. Our packaging solutions are crafted using premium materials and cutting-edge technology to ensure durability and a luxurious feel.

  • Sustainability: We are committed to sustainable practices and offer eco-friendly packaging options. Our goal is to help you achieve a beautiful presentation for your product while minimizing environmental impact.

  • Customer-Centric Approach: Your satisfaction is our top priority. Our team of experts is dedicated to providing exceptional customer service, from initial consultation to final delivery. We work closely with you to understand your needs and exceed your expectations.

Our Expertise

With years of experience in the packaging industry, we have honed our skills to deliver innovative solutions that set your brand apart. Our team of designers, engineers, and customer service professionals is passionate about creating packaging that not only meets your specifications but also adds value to your brand.

Let's Create Something Beautiful Together

At Custom Perfume Boxes, we believe that the right packaging can make all the difference. Let us help you create a memorable unboxing experience for your customers. Contact us today to discuss your packaging needs and discover how we can bring your brand’s vision to life.

title: Privacy Policy
content_html:
At Custom Perfume Boxes, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring that your personal information is handled in a safe and responsible manner. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you visit our website, customperfumeboxes.com, and when you purchase our products or use our services.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

  • Personal Information: When you make a purchase, create an account, or contact us, we may collect personal information such as your name, email address, phone number, billing and shipping address, and payment details.

  • Browsing Information: We may collect non-personal information about your visit to our website, such as your IP address, browser type, device information, and pages viewed. This helps us understand how our site is used and how we can improve the user experience.

  • Cookies and Tracking Technologies: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect information about your browsing activities. Cookies help us remember your preferences and optimize your experience on our website.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect for the following purposes:

  • To Process Orders: We use your personal information to process and fulfill your orders, including shipping, handling payments, and providing customer support.

  • To Improve Our Services: We use browsing information and feedback to enhance our website, products, and services.

  • To Communicate with You: We may use your contact information to send you updates, promotional offers, and other communications related to your orders or our products, unless you opt out of such communications.

  • To Comply with Legal Obligations: We may use your information to comply with legal requirements and regulations.

3. Sharing Your Information

We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. However, we may share your information with:

  • Service Providers: We may share your information with third-party service providers who assist us in operating our website, processing payments, fulfilling orders, and other business functions. These providers are contractually obligated to protect your information and use it only for the services they provide to us.

  • Legal Requirements: We may disclose your information if required by law or if we believe such action is necessary to comply with legal processes, protect our rights, or safeguard others.

4. Security

We take reasonable precautions to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

5. Your Choices

You have the following rights regarding your personal information:

  • Access and Correction: You can access, update, or correct your personal information by logging into your account or contacting us directly.

  • Opt-Out: You may opt out of receiving promotional communications from us by following the unsubscribe instructions in the emails you receive or by contacting us directly.

  • Cookies: You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings. Please note that disabling cookies may affect your ability to use certain features of our website.

6. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these external sites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies before providing any personal information.

7. Children's Privacy

Our website is not intended for use by children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we become aware that we have collected such information, we will take steps to delete it.

8. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We encourage you to review this policy periodically for any updates.

title: Refund and Returns Policy
content_html:
Return Eligibility

Custom Perfume Boxes accepts returns for both defective and non-defective products shipped within the United States.

Returns are accepted only if the product is:

  • Unused

  • Unopened

  • In its original condition and packaging

Products that show signs of use, damage caused after delivery, or improper handling will not be accepted.

Return Window

Customers must initiate a return request within 10 days of receiving their order.

Any return requests made after 10 days from the delivery date will not be eligible for approval.

Return Method

All returns must be made by mail.

Customers are required to contact our support team before sending any product back. Unauthorized returns will not be processed.

Return Process

To request a return, please follow these steps:

  1. Email us at info@customperfumeboxes.com

  2. Include your order number and reason for return

  3. Our team will provide return instructions and confirmation

  4. Ship the item back using the provided details

Return Shipping Label

✅ A return label is included in the package for customer convenience.

Restocking Fee

Custom Perfume Boxes does not charge any restocking fee for returned items.

Refund Processing Time

Once the returned product is received and inspected, refunds will be processed within:

10 business days

Approved refunds will be issued to the original payment method used at the time of purchase.

Non-Returnable Items

The following items are not eligible for return:

  • Custom-made or personalized packaging orders

  • Products damaged due to customer misuse

  • Items returned without prior approval

  • Products returned outside the 10-day window

Damaged or Incorrect Orders

If you receive a defective, damaged, or incorrect product, please notify us within 48 hours of delivery along with clear images. We will arrange a replacement or refund after verification.

Exchange Policy

Currently, we do not offer direct exchanges. Customers may return eligible products and place a new order if needed.

Cancellation Policy

Orders can only be cancelled before production has begun. Once printing or manufacturing starts, cancellations are not possible.

Contact Information

For any return or refund queries, please contact:

Email: info@customperfumeboxes.com

title: Shipping Policy
content_html:
Shipping Coverage

Custom Perfume Boxes currently ships orders within the United States, UK, Canada, Aus & NZ. All products listed on our website are eligible for delivery across the U.S., including residential and commercial addresses.

We ensure accurate delivery timelines and transparent shipping practices to provide customers with clear expectations before placing an order.

Shipping Method

All orders are processed and shipped using trusted third-party courier and logistics partners. Shipping services are selected based on destination and order volume to ensure reliable delivery.

Order Processing Time

Orders are processed after confirmation and design approval.

  • Order cut-off time: 2:00 PM (Pacific Standard Time - PST)

  • Orders placed before 2:00 PM PST are processed the same working day.

  • Orders placed after this time are processed on the next business day.

Handling Time

  • Minimum handling time: 2 business days

  • Maximum handling time: 3 business days

  • Processing Days: Monday to Saturday

This period includes order verification, design finalization, printing preparation, and packaging readiness before dispatch.

Transit Time

Once an order is dispatched, delivery typically takes:

  • Minimum transit time: 3 business days

  • Maximum transit time: 6 business days

  • Shipping Days: Monday to Saturday

Estimated Total Delivery Time

The combined handling and transit duration results in an estimated delivery timeframe of:

5 – 9 business days for all U.S/UK/Canada/Aus destinations

Delivery times may vary slightly depending on location, weather conditions, or courier delays.

Shipping Cost

✅ Free Shipping on All Orders

Custom Perfume Boxes offers free shipping across the U.S/UK/Canada/Aus with no minimum order value required. All orders qualify automatically for free delivery.

There are:

  • No hidden shipping charges

  • No location-based delivery fees

  • No handling fees

Delivery Information

Customers will receive shipping confirmation and tracking details once their order has been dispatched. Tracking updates allow customers to monitor their delivery status in real-time.

Delays & Exceptions

While we strive to meet all estimated delivery times, occasional delays may occur due to:

  • Severe weather conditions

  • Public holidays

  • Carrier service disruptions

  • Incorrect or incomplete shipping information provided by the customer

In such cases, our support team remains available to assist and provide updates.

Incorrect Address Responsibility

Custom Perfume Boxes is not responsible for delays or losses caused by incorrect or incomplete address details provided during checkout. Customers are advised to verify their shipping information carefully before submitting their order.

Contact Information

For any shipping-related questions or concerns, please contact us:

Email: info@customperfumeboxes.com
